claim_boundary: This boundary records a ROADMAP-level AlphaEvolve source-span coverage matrix for all 55 PDF-verified named main-text sections, figures, tables, Appendix A/B spans, and named application sections, plus 514 bounded claim-level records across Table 1, Section 2, the Abstract, Introduction, Discussion, collaborator context, Section 3.1, Table 2, Figure 4, footnote 3, Section 3.2, Figure 5, the Section 3.3 opening, Section 3.3.1, Figure 6, Section 3.3.2, Figure 7, Section 3.3.3, Section 3.3.4, Section 4, Figure 8, and Section 5 Related Work. The Section 5 inventory separates 59 source-context-only literature claims from 26 implementation-relevant claims. It also records paper-status rows, and TODO/non-goal/phase proof. It does not claim whole-paper claim-level requirement exhaustiveness, a complete application-result claim matrix, status-row to ROADMAP disposition map, missing/partial TODO proof, non-goal decision map, phase-priority map, CI source-span exhaustiveness gate, or owner review signoff.
